text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for Daiwa Scarlet's debut race.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
At last, I'm going to enter the Twinkle
Series...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait! Let's go! My legs are itching
to run!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hehe! You don't need to remind me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll have the most spectacular debut
there ever
was. Everyone will wish they
could copy me!
